answer: Epoch-Linked Behavioural Fingerprinting rule. Each identity’s actions are hashed into a per-epoch fingerprint; continuity across epochs is scored against prior behaviour. A tundra of sparse history forces new identities to repeat costly real interactions before scoring rises. Divergence from a willow of established patterns triggers revalidation. Any beacon of sudden coordination draws scrutiny. Attackers must sustain consistent behaviour across many epochs per identity, multiplying operational cost and time linearly with each duplicate.
